source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 26 mai — «Sfânta Muceniță Elena»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Μαΐου — «Αγία Ελένη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar keeps «Sfânta Muceniță Elena» on, with the same bare name and the same rank. The Greek adds a brother and a manner of death, both on the synaxarists' word: «Στους Συναξαριστές αναφέρεται ότι ήταν αδελφή του Αγίου Αβερκίου (βλέπε ίδια ημέρα) και μαρτύρησε δια λιθοβολισμού» — sister of the Abercius kept on the same day, martyred by stoning. She is therefore, on the same page's reckoning, a daughter of the Apostle Alphaeus. She is none of the corpus's other women of this name — not `helen-the-empress`, not `helen-of-sinope`, not `helen-martyr-1943`, and not the `helen-of-decani` drafted from saint.gr's 21 Μαΐου. No year, no place, no hymn.
